summary: Add authenticated private node monitoring during bootstrap and steady operation
details: Start the private control plane after its runtime image is available, without waiting for upstream consensus readiness; reserve its memory during Bitcoin synchronization and preserve it across resource transitions.

Export sanitized host progress through an independent systemd observer and a read-only mount. Display snapshot completion, foreground synchronization, background validation, resources, mining, and freshness independently; stale observations never certify current readiness.
Require private-console token authentication, enforce browser Host/Origin checks, and disable development wallet endpoints by default. Service probes run concurrently with a short shared cache.
operator_actions: Upgrade the node kit and services image together using the normal node upgrade procedure. Existing installations should run usdb-node controller install and usdb-node console start to install the observer and update the console.

Use an SSH tunnel to the loopback console and obtain the login token with usdb-node console token. Foreground installations without systemd must run usdb-node console monitor separately for continuous host observations.
